title: Activity Template
description: Input to the generation path Template -> Generator -> candidate -> validation -> finalized ActivityDefinition (ADR-0014). The same Template serves every timing; only when the path runs and where the result is stored differ. It declares everything that is not a model decision (skills, difficulty, evaluator, tools, image, remediation) and bounds what the Generator may compose: only the listed fixtures and checks, all registered in a domain adapter (ADR-0009). The candidate shape is contracts/schemas/llm/generator.activity_candidate/1.json. Withheld from the learner and from the tutor context: the brief may describe the fault.

produces.description: Kind of Definition generated. v0.1 generates activities only.

holdout.description: True for a holdout Template (ADR-0011). A holdout Template is always 'authoring': an explicit other timing is rejected here, and the Importer also rejects a holdout Template that would inherit a non-authoring pack default (ADR-0014, AC-J5).

timing.description: Overrides manifest content_generation.default_timing for this Template.

allowed_fixtures.description: Fixture providers the Generator may compose. Empty for a Template without a lab.

allowed_checks.description: Deterministic checks the Generator may compose.

image.description: Lab image for generated environments. Fixed by the Template; never chosen by the Generator. Null for a Template without a lab.

solution_step_timeout_seconds.description: Copied onto every reference-solution step at materialization (the candidate carries no timeouts).

brief.description: Author instructions to the Generator: the failure class to build, constraints, what the mission must not reveal.

allOf.description: A lab-backed Template (any allowed fixture) must pin an image.
